title: Sebastian and the Extraction
author: Beatrix Winterbourne
blurb: Ines Crane, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
